parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the application group.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region. Set the value to cn-hangzhou.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oos get-application-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --name MyApplicationGroup --application-name MyApplication --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun oos GetApplicationGroup --region cn-hangzhou --ApplicationName MyApplication --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Name MyApplicationGroup
